title: [Trend] API key rotation breaks production auth (17 similar)
summary:
Support trend: after API key rotation, production authentication fails while the same request succeeds in test.

Expected behavior: rotated keys continue to authenticate production traffic without downtime.
Actual behavior: production returns 401; test environment succeeds with the same key payload.

Customer impact: 18 tickets, 16 accounts, 9 enterprise; est. ARR at risk $979K.

Recommend Engineering review for a systemic auth regression.
expected_behavior: Rotated API keys authenticate production traffic without downtime.
actual_behavior: Production returns 401; identical requests succeed in test.
reproduction_steps:
1. Rotate API key in admin.
2. Send authenticated request to production.
3. Observe 401. Repeat against test — succeeds.
environment: Production us-east-1, API gateway v2.4, Northstar Cloud enterprise tenants.
